messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [P1] External model artifact fetch failures (Hugging Face) observed — 429s from hf.co when fetching large checkpoints; hit threshold for cold-start failures. Paging oncall.

maria (oncall): Acknowledged — I'm looking. Which fleets/regions affected?

ben (eng-runtime): Seeing elevated model fetch errors in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Error pattern: 429 rate limit on GET /models/*/revisions/*/files/*, plus some 5xx. Cold-start failures spiking for 8xx containers trying to pull large gx-checkpoint.bin.

tom: Repro steps in prod: loader does sequential fetch + unzip; retries use exponential backoff (default 2 retries). With the hf 429 this often exhausts retries and container fails ready probe.

jia: Metrics: model_fetch_success_rate for prod-inference decreased from 99.8% -> 92% over last 15m. Coldstart_failure_rate up 6x. Customers on high-concurrency LBs seeing higher latencies.

lina (support): We already have two customers who reported degraded latency for document-summarize flows. CS is triaging and emailing known affected accounts.

maria (oncall): Initial mitigation plan: 1) Increase fetch retries and jitter in loader, 2) Enable immediate fallback to cached quantized variant (if available) for models failing fetch, 3) Kick off pre-warm job in affected regions to pull artifacts to local cache. Ben/jia, can you help implement 1+2?

ben (eng-runtime): On it. I'll push a temporary change to loader config: retries=6, backoff_base=1.2s, max_backoff=30s, and tolerate partial pull by loading transformer weights from shard files where possible. Pushing patch to canary in us-west-2 now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started deploy of eng-runtime/loader@hotfix/model-fetch-retry to canary/us-west-2.

sre-pager: Noted — please add an exclude for very large sharded checkpoints to avoid long single-file fetches as a quick optimization. Also consider serving from our S3 mirror if HF returns 429s.

ben (eng-runtime): Added mirror fallback: if hf.co returns 429 for >3 attempts, try internal S3 mirror endpoint (mirror-internal.redwood.s3.amazonaws.com). Will instrument metric mirror_fallback_used.

maria (oncall): Pre-warm plan: run prefetch job to download top-20 hot models into cache nodes. Jian/Tom can you schedule now? This should reduce coldstarts for the next 30m.

tom: Kickoff script posted:
```
# prefetch top models
./tools/prefetch_models --region us-west-2 --models-file hot_models.txt --parallel 8 --target-cache cache-cluster-42
```
Launching now.

hf-status-bot: Hugging Face API status: "Partial degradation affecting some artifact downloads in multiple regions" — https://status.huggingface.co/incidents/abcd1234

jia: Opened an incident ticket with HF support, included logs, request ids, and sample 429 responses. HF asked for rate-limit headers — attaching sample: `x-rate-limit-limit: 2000`, `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 167` (seconds).

maria (oncall): Customer impact assessment: currently ~1.8% of requests hitting failure fallback (quantized model) — estimated ~120k affected token-generating requests last hour. We should notify status page. Lina, prepare a short customer-facing update indicating we're mitigating and using fallbacks.

lina (support): Draft: "We've observed degraded model loading from a third-party artifact host (Hugging Face). We've applied mitigations (increased retries, mirror fallback, and cached fallbacks). Some requests may experience higher latency or fallback to smaller model variants. We'll update as we know more." Sending to legal for signoff, posting to status in 10m.

ben (eng-runtime): Canary shows model_fetch_success_rate improved from 88% -> 97% after loader retry/mirror changes in canary cluster. Telemetry indicates mirror_fallback_used=240 in canary. Rolling to prod/us-west-2 next.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started roll of eng-runtime/loader@hotfix to prod/us-west-2 (gradual).

maria (oncall): While rolling, let's also disable aggressive readiness probe failure (increase probe timeout) to avoid killing containers during long pulls. Ben, can you include that in the rollout?

ben (eng-runtime): Included. readiness.timeout -> 90s for canary/prod rollout.

sre-pager: Reminder to add an automated circuit-breaker: if model fetch failure rate > 3% for 10m, divert new requests to warm cached pool and scale the pool. Filed POA-345.

jia: Metrics after rollout (10m): region us-west-2 success rate at 98.2%, coldstart failure rate back to baseline. EU region still seeing intermittent 429s — rolling same changes there now.

hf-status-bot: HF update: "Incident identified, working on rate limit adjustments and CDN scaling. ETA 1-2 hours".

maria (oncall): Next steps: 1) Continue rolling runtime changes globally, 2) keep mirror fallback enabled for 2 hours, 3) keep pre-warm job running for top models for next 60m, 4) monitor customer impact and post status update. Assigning handoff to tom for next 2-hour window.

maria (oncall): Handoff summary for tom: root cause external HF rate-limits causing artifact fetch 429s; mitigations applied: increased retries, mirror fallback to internal S3, readiness timeout increase, pre-warm cache job, fallback to quantized smaller variants for failed loads. Current status: steady, partial degradation but falling; HF investigating. See metric dashboard: link redacted.

tom: Ack — taking oncall. Will continue roll to eu-west-1 and ap-south-1, keep CS updated, and escalate if HF ETA slips.

lina (support): Posted status update to status.redwood.ai: "Third-party artifact host affecting model fetches. Mitigations applied. We are monitoring; updates hourly."

sre-pager: Added follow-up item: post-incident playbook update to include mirror fallback and pre-warm automation (owner: ben).

tom: Quick note — customers with strict model verifiability: we should log when fallback to mirror or quantized variant occurred so audits can reconcile. Filing audit task.

maria (oncall): Good call. Ben please add tracing header x-fetch-fallback: mirror|quantized to the request logs.

ben (eng-runtime): Done — added header and metric.

hf-status-bot: HF update: "Rate limit temporarily increased for key partners; monitoring for stability."

tom: All regions rolled or rolling, metrics look stable. I'll keep thread open and update if HF resolves or we see regressions.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-2117654321. Severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 at 2117654480 (stabilized).

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Tom — please confirm stable for 30m then close incident. Lina, prepare post-incident customer note outlining mitigation and recommended long-term actions (mirror + prefetch + SLA with HF).

tom: Will monitor and update in 30m.
